summary: Restoration commitments include at least 18,000 ha of reforestation/afforestation, improved growing stock on 200,000 ha and a separate 278,000-ha intervention, 1,000 ha of coastal/mangrove restoration, 150 ha/year of mangrove restoration, and restoration of 10% of degraded climate-sensitive landscapes by 2035; other pledges cover 25% of identified degraded terrestrial, wetland, fog-zone and riparian landscapes. Conservation expands integrated management across 15 river basins and 47 fisheries areas, protects 38 coastal/marine sites, and targets ex-situ conservation of 6,500 species. Agriculture scales input-efficient farming from 50% of the target area in 2025 to 100% by 2030, alongside irrigation, soil, water and productivity measures. Mixed pledges aim for 32% forest cover and nearly four million trees over ten years. However, Sentinel-3 maps forest at 37% of land in 2022, so 32% is below the current mapped share; 18,000 ha is only 0.7% of current forest area.
